vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: neomano-vps-monitoring
Version: 0.1.0

The skill bundle provides a legitimate tool for monitoring DigitalOcean droplets using the official DigitalOcean API. The Python script (scripts/do_metrics.py) uses standard libraries to fetch and summarize performance metrics (CPU, memory, disk, bandwidth) and only communicates with api.digitalocean.com. No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward DigitalOcean droplet/metrics helper that legitimately needs a DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN and python3; the only notable issue is a metadata mismatch where the registry record does not declare those requirements.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name and description match its code and instructions: it lists droplets and fetches monitoring metrics from DigitalOcean. It legitimately requires a DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN and python3. However, the registry metadata (requirements section) claims no required env vars or binaries, while SKILL.md and the script both require python3 and DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN — this packaging/metadata inconsistency should be corrected.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the included Python script and only references DigitalOcean API endpoints. The script only reads DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN from the environment, lists droplets, and queries api.digitalocean.com for metrics. It does not reference other system files, other environment variables, or external endpoints beyond the official DigitalOcean API.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only with an included script), so nothing is downloaded or written by an installer. Runtime requires python3 but no packages are installed by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only secret used is DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN, which is appropriate for a DigitalOcean-monitoring tool. The script does not request unrelated credentials or access other config paths. Ensure the token has minimal privileges needed (read-only/monitoring) where possible.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request permanent/always-on presence or modify agent/system configurations. It runs only when invoked and uses only the provided token and network calls to DigitalOcean.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears to be a legitimate DigitalOcean monitoring helper. Before installing: (1) correct or confirm the registry metadata — SKILL.md and the script require python3 and DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN even though the registry entry lists none; (2) create a DigitalOcean token with the minimal scopes needed (prefer read/monitoring-only if available) and avoid using a full admin token; (3) review the included scripts yourself (they are short and readable) and run them locally to verify behavior; (4) do not paste the token into public places and store it in a secure location (e.g., your agent's secret store or a local secure env file). If you need higher assurance, ask the publisher to update the registry metadata to declare the required env var and binary.
